items.title: What is a full head color?
items.html: A full head color is a hair coloring service where one single shade is applied from roots to tips for a uniform look.

items.title: What is the difference between full head color and all-over color?
items.html: There is no difference—both terms refer to applying one consistent color across the entire hair.

items.title: How long does a full head color appointment take?
items.html: Application usually takes 20–30 minutes, with additional processing time depending on the desired result.

items.title: Who is a full head color best for?
items.html: It’s ideal for refreshing existing color, covering gray hair, or achieving a completely new uniform shade.

items.title: How much does full head color cost in NYC?
items.html: Prices typically start around $150+, depending on hair length, thickness, and styling.

items.title: Does full head color include styling?
items.html: Yes, most services include a professional blow-dry finish after coloring.
